name: 局部编辑
summary: 在图片上涂抹要修改的区域，再用文字描述想要的效果，区域外保持不变。
author: Glance

commands.name: 局部编辑
commands.description: 输入一张图片，涂抹出要修改的区域，并用文字描述想要的效果，例如“移除这个人”或“换成一盆绿植”。涂抹区域以外的画面保持不变。

prompt.description: 描述涂抹区域想要的效果，支持中文和英文 / Describe what the painted area should become, in any language.

mask.description: 涂抹区域的蒙版 PNG：不透明的白色表示要修改的区域 / Mask PNG: opaque white marks the area to change.

privacy.notice: 图片、涂抹区域和文字描述将上传至 Glance 及 AI 图像服务处理。 / Your image, painted mask and description are uploaded to Glance and an AI image service for processing.

en.name: Edit Area
en.summary: Paint the area to change, describe the result in text, and everything outside it stays as is.

run.name: Edit Area
run.description: Provide one image, paint the area to change and describe the result, for example “remove this person” or “replace it with a potted plant”. Everything outside the painted area stays unchanged.
